table.name: permit_type

row.name: permit_type_code
row.comment: Stable business code for the permit type.

row.name: description
row.comment: Plain-language permit type name shown to applicants.

row.name: effective_date
row.comment: First date on which the permit type may be selected.

row.name: expiry_date
row.comment: Last date on which the permit type may be selected; null while current.

table.comment: Controlled list of permit types offered by the program.
table.records-schedule: Permit type reference list: retain until the list is superseded, then destroy (ORCS 99999-01, placeholder; confirm with the records officer)

table.name: permit_application

row.name: permit_application_id
row.comment: Surrogate key generated by the database.

row.name: application_number
row.comment: Business identifier quoted to the applicant.

row.name: site_location
row.comment: Proposed site. Physical type geometry(Point,3005) in PostGIS; portable-v1 has no spatial type, so the designer stores it as text.

table.comment: Permit applications submitted by the public.
table.records-schedule: Permit application files: retain 7 years after the permit is closed, then destroy (ORCS 99999-20, placeholder; confirm with the records officer)
